messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I'm not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you give me the store ID or the full address so I can make sure I'm transferring to the right location?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]
CALLER: I don't know the address, I just moved here. Can't you just tell me which ones there are?
AGENT: I can search for Harbor stores in Lakeview. Let me do that. We have three Harbor locations in Lakeview. Which one sounds right—the one downtown at 120 Main, the one near the university at 2250 Main, or the one north of Main inside Northgate Mall?  [system actions: find_stores]
CALLER: Near Oak, that's the one by my apartment.
AGENT: Perfect, that's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Now let me get your prescriptions from Brightway so I can transfer the albuterol and sertraline. I'm not seeing any prescriptions in our system for you. Those medications are at Brightway, so they're not in our Harbor records yet. To transfer them, Brightway will need to send them to us. Can you call Brightway and ask them to transfer your albuterol and sertraline to Harbor Pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, or would you like me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to them?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, just have your pharmacist call them so I don't have to deal with it. That's easier for me.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll flag our pharmacist to contact Brightway about transferring those two medications for you. Done. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to get those transferred over for you. I'll also set your default store to the Harbor on Main near Oak Street. All set. Your home pharmacy is now the Harbor at 2250 Main near Oak, and our pharmacist will reach out to Brightway about your transfer.  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback, set_default_store]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent first asks which Main St store he means without offering options
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered options later, not without offering them"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No store ID H-302 or address confirmed"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
